entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
SUPPORT! And I want to talk to a person, not a machine!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac with VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Finally! Look, I bought a jersey from you guys a couple of months ago and it's completely useless. I want to return it right now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF8675309. I don't know what kind of sizing you use, but this thing is way too tight. I ordered a Large and it fits like a Small. It's the wrong size and I can barely breathe in it.

Thank you for that, one moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Racing Jersey, delivered on October 24th. That was 64 days ago. Let me just check our return eligibility for you.
Don't 'check the eligibility', just process the return. If you try to deny this, I swear I'm going to speak to your manager and my review online is going to be brutal.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for that. I've just confirmed, and good news, your item is still well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you. Did you want a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Well, it's about time. I need an XL. But this whole process has been a huge waste of my time. You should have gotten the sizing right in the first place.

I completely agree, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. I see here that you're one of our VIP customers, and we really value your business. To make this right, I've processed the exchange for the XL jersey, and I've upgraded the shipping to our fastest priority service at no charge to you. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label for the one that's too tight. You can just drop it in the mail at your convenience.
Oh. Well... okay. Free priority shipping?

Yes, absolutely. It's the least we can do. You should see that confirmation email with the tracking for the new jersey and the return label in your inbox within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's it. That's... acceptable. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
